# Jobsnap — Design Notes

## Structure Order

1. Header (white bg, brand text left, nav right)
2. Hero (full-width background image, no text overlay)
3. Search Form Bar (white card overlaying hero bottom, horizontal layout)
   - Text input with magnifying glass icon + "Search Jobs..." placeholder
   - Categories dropdown
   - Search button (blue, rounded)
4. Footer (Component Dock link)

## Fidelity Notes

- The template is very simple — essentially just a header, hero image, and a search bar overlay.
- No content sections below the hero (the original is a bare-bones search form demo).
- The search card sits at the bottom edge of the hero, overlapping it slightly.
- Blue brand color is used consistently for header text and the search button.
- Placeholder image should evoke a warm/neutral professional tone (pseudos with picsum seed).
